notes.title: The Basement V 1.5.0
notes.content:
A Lot has changed! We changed the game engine to Godot for several reasons - primarilyfor the mobile users and future updates:

[list]
[*] Reduced storage requirements
[*] Increased Performance
[*] Enhanced physics
[*] Enhanced enemy ai
[*] Solved many game breaking bugs
[/list]

But this changes comes at a cost... Unfortunately save states cannot be transferred to the newest version. This also happened with the other engine all the time. Now we've got a new solution and this should be the last save reset again. To cover your loss, you receive 1000 MindCoins! Checout the store and have fun with the customizations!
